license_required.quote: Any person acting as a broker or as a salesperson without first obtaining a license is guilty of a misdemeanor

issuing_authority.value: Department of Business Regulation, Real Estate Division
issuing_authority.quote: A certificate of licensure shall be issued by the real estate division of the department of business regulation

name.value: Department of Business Regulation, Real Estate Division
name.quote: A certificate of licensure shall be issued by the real estate division of the department of business regulation

type.quote: A certificate of licensure shall be issued by the real estate division of the department of business regulation

umbrella_agency.quote: Within the department of business regulation there is created the Rhode Island real estate commission

age_minimum.quote: The applicant must be a citizen or legal resident of the United States and at least legal age of majority, if applicant for broker license, or at least eighteen (18) years of age for salesperson license.

moral_character_required.quote: the names of at least three (3) Rhode Island residents who have known the applicant for three (3) years, and are not related to the applicant and will attest that the applicant bears a good reputation for honesty and trustworthiness, and who will recommend that a license be granted to the applicant

degree_required.value: Minimum 90 hours of approved classroom study in an approved school or equivalent correspondence course from an accredited college or university
degree_required.quote: Has successfully completed at least ninety (90) hours of approved classroom study in a school as defined in § 5-20.5-19, or equivalent in a correspondence course offered by an extension department of an accredited college or university

degree_level.quote: Has successfully completed at least ninety (90) hours of approved classroom study in a school as defined in § 5-20.5-19, or equivalent in a correspondence course offered by an extension department of an accredited college or university

school_approval_basis.quote: Any school, individual, or organization that offers or conducts any course or courses of study in real estate … shall first obtain a permit from, and subsequently abide by the rules and regulations of, the division covering those schools.

credential_pegged.quote: Has successfully completed at least ninety (90) hours of approved classroom study in a school as defined in § 5-20.5-19

required.quote: Has been engaged full time as a real estate salesperson for at least two (2) years immediately prior to the date of application

experience_source.quote: Has been engaged full time as a real estate salesperson for at least two (2) years immediately prior to the date of application

duration.quote: Has been engaged full time as a real estate salesperson for at least two (2) years immediately prior to the date of application

kind.quote: Has been engaged full time as a real estate salesperson for at least two (2) years immediately prior to the date of application

exams.name: Rhode Island Real Estate Licensing Examination (broker)
exams.notes: Written examination covering state statutes, rules, regulations, deeds, mortgages, leases, contracts, real estate relationships, and fair housing laws. Attorneys licensed by the RI Supreme Court are exempt. Applicants from reciprocal states may be waived from the uniform portion.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered by a testing service under contract with the Department of Business Regulation)
exams.quote: The director shall require any applicant for a real estate broker's or salesperson's license to submit to and pass a written examination to show the applicant's knowledge of the state statutes and the rules and regulations relating to real property

interval_years.quote: all applicants for a renewal license for real estate brokers or real estate salespersons shall submit proof to the director that they have completed during the preceding two-year (2) period, a minimum of twenty-four (24) classroom hours

required.quote: all applicants for a renewal license for real estate brokers or real estate salespersons shall submit proof to the director that they have completed during the preceding two-year (2) period, a minimum of twenty-four (24) classroom hours of real estate oriented educational sessions or courses of instruction

hours_per_period.quote: a minimum of twenty-four (24) classroom hours of real estate oriented educational sessions or courses of instruction that have been previously approved by the director

period_years.quote: they have completed during the preceding two-year (2) period, a minimum of twenty-four (24) classroom hours

value: federal, Rhode Island, or local laws pertaining to fair housing and the treatment of any individual in a protected class (minimum 3 hours)
lead poisoning prevention act and lead hazard mitigation act (reasonable familiarity)
topical_requirements.quote: A minimum of three (3) classroom hours shall be comprised of instruction about federal, Rhode Island, or local laws pertaining to fair housing and the treatment of any individual in a protected class

available.quote: The director shall recognize the license issued to a real estate broker by another state as satisfactorily qualifying him or her for a license as a broker in this state; provided that the other state permits licenses to be issued to licensed brokers in this state without examination

requirements.value: The other state must offer reciprocal licensing without examination to RI licensees, and the applicant must meet RI licensing requirements (§ 5-20.5-4). Nonresident brokers who maintain a place of business and license in a reciprocal state need not maintain an office in RI. For the uniform portion of the exam, waiver is available if the applicant holds a valid license from a state with similar statutes providing for reciprocal waiver.
requirements.quote: provided that the other state permits licenses to be issued to licensed brokers in this state without examination and provided that the licensing requirements set forth in § 5-20.5-4 have been met

exists.quote: Within the department of business regulation there is created the Rhode Island real estate commission

name.quote: Within the department of business regulation there is created the Rhode Island real estate commission, subsequently referred to as "commission"

authority.value: Policy-making role in preparation and composition of examinations; supervises operations of the real estate division in an advisory capacity; promulgation of policy subject to approval of the director; consent required for director to issue rules and regulations governing conduct of licensees
authority.quote: The commission shall supervise the operations of the real estate division within the department of business regulation in an advisory capacity in promulgating any policy that is necessary to improve the operations of the real estate division within the department of business regulation in their areas of expertise. The promulgation of that policy is subject to the approval of the director.

regulatory_model.quote: Any person acting as a broker or as a salesperson without first obtaining a license is guilty of a misdemeanor

credential_type.quote: the director shall issue to the applicant a license to act as a real estate broker or a real estate salesperson

approximate.matched_normalized: shall issue to the applicant a license to act as a real estate broker or a real estate salesperson

is_mandatory.quote: Any person acting as a broker or as a salesperson without first obtaining a license is guilty of a misdemeanor

title_protection.quote: Any person acting as a broker or as a salesperson without first obtaining a license is guilty of a misdemeanor

scope_protection.quote: Any person acting as a broker or as a salesperson without first obtaining a license is guilty of a misdemeanor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any substantial misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any substantial misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any false promise likely to influence a person to enter a contract when the licensee could not or did not intend to keep it
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any false promise of a character likely to influence, persuade, or induce any person to enter into any contract or agreement when he or she could not or did not intend to keep that promise

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pursuing a continued and flagrant course of misrepresentation or false promises through any medium
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Pursuing a continued and flagrant course of misrepresentation or making of false promises through salespersons, other persons, or any medium of advertising, or otherwise

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any misleading or untruthful advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any misleading or untruthful advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to deposit customer funds into an escrow account upon execution of a purchase and sales agreement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to deposit money or other customers' funds received by a broker or salesperson into an escrow account maintained by the broker that complies with the requirements set forth in § 5-20.5-26, upon execution of a purchase and sales agreement

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to preserve records relating to real estate transactions for three years following consummation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to preserve for three (3) years following its consummation records relating to any real estate transaction as described in the regulations issued by the department

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without written knowledge and consent of all parties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without the knowledge and consent, in writing, of all parties for whom he or she acts

disciplinary_grounds.description: Placing a 'for sale' or 'for rent' sign on any property without written consent of the owner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Placing a "for sale" or "for rent" sign on any property without the written consent of the owner, or his or her authorized agent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to furnish a copy of any listing, sale, lease, or other contract to all signatories at time of execution
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to furnish a copy of any listing, sale, lease, or other contract relevant to a real estate transaction to all signatories of the contract at the time of execution

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to specify a definite termination date not subject to prior notice in any listing contract
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to specify a definite termination date that is not subject to prior notice, in any listing contract

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inducing a party to break a contract to substitute a new one for the licensee's personal gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inducing any party to a contract, sale, or lease to break that contract for the purpose of substitution in lieu of that contract a new contract, where that substitution is motivated by the personal gain of the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: A salesperson accepting a commission from any person other than their affiliated licensed broker
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting a commission or any valuable consideration by a salesperson for the performance of any acts specified in this chapter, from any person, except the licensed real estate broker with whom he or she is affiliated

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to disclose to an owner the licensee's intent to purchase or acquire interest in listed property
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to disclose to an owner his or her intention or true position if he or she, directly or indirectly through a third party, purchases for himself or herself or acquires or intends to acquire any interest in or any option to purchase property that has been listed with his or her office to sell or lease

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of a criminal felony involving dishonesty, breach of trust, fraud, or similar offenses
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted of any criminal felony in a court of competent jurisdiction of this or any other state or federal court involving dishonesty, breach of trust, forgery, embezzlement, obtaining money under false pretenses, bribery, larceny, extortion, conspiracy to defraud, fraud, false dealing, or any similar offense(s)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any rule or regulation promulgated by the department in the interest of the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any rule or regulation promulgated by the department in the interest of the public and consistent with the provisions of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to exercise adequate supervision over the activities of licensed salespersons (broker licensees)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In the case of a broker licensee, failing to exercise adequate supervision over the activities of his or her licensed salesperson within the scope of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing or refusing to provide information requested by the commission or director as a result of a complaint
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing or refusing to provide information requested by the commission or director as the result of a formal or informal complaint to the director that would indicate a violation of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting or offering real property by offering free lots, lotteries, contests, or prizes to influence purchasers
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Soliciting, selling, or offering for sale real property by offering free lots or conducting lotteries or contests or offering prizes for the purpose of influencing a purchaser or prospective purchaser of real property

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying or accepting any undisclosed commission, rebate, compensation, or profit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying or accepting, giving, or charging any undisclosed commission, rebate, compensation, or profit or expenditures for a principal or in violation of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct in a real estate transaction demonstrating bad faith, dishonesty, untrustworthiness, or incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct in a real estate transaction that demonstrates bad faith, dishonesty, untrustworthiness, or incompetence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to have all listing agreements in writing with all required terms and a definite expiration date
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to have all listing agreements in writing, properly identifying the property and containing all of the terms and conditions of the sale, including the commission to be paid, the signatures of all parties concerned, and a definite expiration date

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting a listing based on 'net price'
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting a listing based on "net price."

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negotiating with an owner knowing they have an outstanding exclusive listing with another licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Negotiating, or attempting to negotiate, the sale, exchange, or lease of any real property directly with an owner or lessor knowing that the owner or lessor has an outstanding exclusive listing contract with another licensee covering the same property

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting an exclusive right to sell/lease and failing to make a diligent effort to sell or lease the property
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting an exclusive right to sell or lease or an exclusive agency and subsequently failing to make a diligent effort to sell or lease the listed property

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advising against the use of the services of an attorney in any real estate transaction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advising against the use of the services of an attorney in any real estate transaction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing to a lender or other interested party an amount other than the true and actual sales price
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing to any lender or any other party in interest, either verbally or through the preparation of a false sales contract, an amount other than the true and actual sales price

disciplinary_grounds.description: Submitting a written offer to purchase or lease without all essential terms and conditions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Submitting to an owner a written offer to purchase or lease unless that offer contains the essential terms and conditions of the offer, including the manner in which the purchase price is to be paid

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying escrow funds without complying with department rules on transfer of disputed deposits to the general treasurer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying any sums of money being held in an escrow account to any person, or converting the sums of money for his or her own use, in the event of a failed real estate transaction, without having complied with the department's rules and regulations relative to the transfer of disputed deposit funds to the office of the general treasurer

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising to sell or buy property in a manner indicating the offer is by a private party not engaged in real estate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising to sell, buy, exchange, rent, or lease the property of another in a manner indicating that the offer to sell, buy, exchange, rent, or lease that property is being made by a private party not engaged in the real estate business

disciplinary_grounds.description: Salesperson failing to return all information, records, or materials to broker upon termination of employment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: As a licensed salesperson, failing upon termination of his or her employment or affiliation with a real estate broker and upon demand by the broker to immediately turn over to the broker any and all information, records, or other materials obtained during his or her employment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering, giving, or paying any part of a commission to an unlicensed person who should be licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering, promising, giving, or paying, directly or indirectly, any part or share of his or her commission or compensation arising or accruing from any real estate transaction to any person who is not licensed as a real estate broker, but who, by law, should be licensed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating fair housing laws including blockbusting or distributing materials to induce sales based on protected class
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating chapter 37 of title 34 in his or her capacity as a real estate licensee, including, but not limited to, soliciting the sale, lease, or the listing for sale or lease, of residential property on the ground of loss of value due to the present or prospective entry in the neighborhood of a person or persons of another race, religion, or ethnic origin

disciplinary_grounds.description: Broker failing to notify the director within 10 days of salesperson's termination, or salesperson failing to notify of broker affiliation change
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of the employing broker to notify the director, in writing, within ten (10) days of the termination of a salesperson's employment or contractual relationship, or failure of a salesperson to notify the director, in writing, within ten (10) days of any change in his or her broker affiliation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report all written offers to the owner prior to signing a purchase and sale agreement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to report all written offers to the owner prior to the signing of a purchase and sale agreement by the owner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide buyers and sellers with disclosure regarding real estate agency relationships
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of agents to provide buyers and sellers of real property with disclosure regarding real estate agency relationships as specified in chapter 20.6 of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of an associate broker to inform the public of associate broker status on business cards and correspondence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of an associate broker to inform the public of associate broker status by not listing associate broker on business cards and correspondence or by informing the public that his or her status in the real estate firm is that of broker

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay escrow funds within 10 days of receipt of written release signed by all parties to a failed transaction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to pay sums of money being held in an escrow account, pursuant to § 5-20.5-26, within ten (10) days of receipt of a written release that has been signed by all parties to a failed real estate transaction

bonding_required.quote: the director shall, upon application by his or her legal representative, issue, without examination, a temporary license to that legal representative, or to an individual designated by him or her and approved by the director, upon filing of the required bond and the payment of the prescribed fee

insurance_required.quote: All holders of real estate brokers' and salespersons' licenses issued by the state department of business regulation shall, as a condition of retaining that license, carry and maintain errors and omissions insurance covering all business activities contemplated.

definition_quote.value: Within the meaning of this chapter, includes all persons, partnerships, associations, and corporations, foreign and domestic, who or that: For a fee, commission, or other valuable consideration, or with the intention or expectation of receiving or collecting a fee, commission, or other valuable consideration, lists, sells, purchases, exchanges, rents, leases, prepares an opinion of value, or auctions any real estate, or the improvements on real estate including options or who negotiates or attempts to negotiate any such activity; Advertises or holds himself or herself, itself, or themselves out as engaged in those activities; Directs or assists in the procuring of a purchaser or prospect calculated or intended to result in a real estate transaction.
definition_quote.quote: For a fee, commission, or other valuable consideration, or with the intention or expectation of receiving or collecting a fee, commission, or other valuable consideration, lists, sells, purchases, exchanges, rents, leases, prepares an opinion of value, or auctions any real estate, or the improvements on real estate including options or who negotiates or attempts to negotiate any such activity

value: advertising as engaged in real estate activities
procuring purchasers or prospects for real estate transactions
methods_authorized.quote: lists, sells, purchases, exchanges, rents, leases, prepares an opinion of value, or auctions any real estate, or the improvements on real estate including options or who negotiates or attempts to negotiate any such activity

license_tiers.quote: "Associate broker" means any licensed real estate broker employed or engaged as an independent contractor by or on behalf of a licensed real estate broker

broker_of_record_required.quote: The real estate broker's license issued to any corporation, partnership, or association shall designate the name of the one principal active officer of the corporation, partnership, or association for whom that license is valid

pre_exam_experience_years.quote: Has been engaged full time as a real estate salesperson for at least two (2) years immediately prior to the date of application

pre_exam_instruction_hours.quote: Has successfully completed at least ninety (90) hours of approved classroom study in a school as defined in § 5-20.5-19, or equivalent in a correspondence course offered by an extension department of an accredited college or university

value: state statutes and rules and regulations relating to real property
federal and state fair housing laws pertaining to fair housing and the treatment of any individual in a protected class
required_instruction_topics.quote: to show the applicant's knowledge of the state statutes and the rules and regulations relating to real property, deeds, mortgages, leases, contracts, real estate relationships, and federal and state fair housing laws pertaining to fair housing and the treatment of any individual in a protected class

exam_application_window_years.quote: Any successful applicant who fails to remit the original license fee as provided in § 5-20.5-11 within one year of the date of that examination may be required by the director to re-submit to and pass a written examination

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without the knowledge and consent, in writing, of all parties for whom he or she acts

initial_interview_disclosure_required.quote: Failure of agents to provide buyers and sellers of real property with disclosure regarding real estate agency relationships as specified in chapter 20.6 of this title

written_service_agreement_required.quote: Failing to have all listing agreements in writing, properly identifying the property and containing all of the terms and conditions of the sale, including the commission to be paid, the signatures of all parties concerned, and a definite expiration date in that contract

value: essential terms and conditions of the offer
manner in which the purchase price is to be paid
sales_contract_mandatory_disclosures.quote: Submitting to an owner a written offer to purchase or lease unless that offer contains the essential terms and conditions of the offer, including the manner in which the purchase price is to be paid, and if that offer is contingent upon certain conditions, those conditions shall be clearly stated in the offer

listing_contract_termination_date_requir.quote: Failing to specify a definite termination date that is not subject to prior notice, in any listing contract

transaction_record_retention_years.quote: Failing to preserve for three (3) years following its consummation records relating to any real estate transaction as described in the regulations issued by the department

escrow_account_required.quote: Each real estate firm shall maintain an escrow account under the supervision of the broker qualified to do business in the name and on behalf of the corporate, partnership, or association licensee.

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: A broker or salesperson shall not commingle deposit money or other customers' funds and his or her own funds

fixed_office_required.quote: Each resident licensed real estate broker must maintain a fixed office within this state.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: "Real estate salesperson" means and includes any person employed or engaged as an independent contractor by or on behalf of a licensed real estate broker

recovery_fund_exists.quote: The department of business regulation shall establish and maintain a real estate recovery account from which any person aggrieved by an act, representation, transaction, or conduct of a licensed real estate broker or real estate salesperson, upon the grounds of fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit, may recover

recovery_fund_max_per_claim.quote: an amount of not more than fifty thousand dollars ($50,000) for damages sustained by the fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit

recovery_fund_max_per_licensee.quote: the liability of that portion of the real estate recovery account allocated for the purposes of the real estate recovery account shall not exceed fifty thousand dollars ($50,000) for any one licensee

broker_price_opinion_permitted.quote: "Opinion of value" means an analysis, opinion, or conclusion prepared by a person licensed under this chapter, in the ordinary course of his or her business relating to the price of specified interests in or aspects of identified real estate or identified real property or by comparison to other real property currently or recently sold in the marketplace for the purpose of listing, purchase, or sale

comparative_market_analysis_permitted.quote: "Opinion of value" means an analysis, opinion, or conclusion prepared by a person licensed under this chapter, in the ordinary course of his or her business relating to the price of specified interests in or aspects of identified real estate or identified real property or by comparison to other real property currently or recently sold in the marketplace for the purpose of listing, purchase, or sale

value: Bona fide owners, lessees, or lessors performing acts as to property owned or leased by them, or to their regular employees, where those acts are performed in the regular course of, or as an incident to the management of the property and the investment in the property

Persons, partnerships, associations, or corporations, or any of their employees, who seek to acquire, lease, rent, sell, or deal in real estate that has been or will be used or held for investment by that person, partnership, association, or corporation
Any attorney at law licensed by the supreme court of the state or any person holding in good faith an executed power of attorney from the owner
Any person acting as a receiver, trustee, administrator, executor, guardian, or under court order, or while acting under authority of a deed of trust or will

Any person, partnership, association, or corporation who appraises real or personal property for the purpose of conducting a mass appraisal, municipal revaluation for tax purposes, or other forms of ad valorem appraisal
Public officers while performing their duties as public officers
license_exemptions.quote: Neither the term "real estate broker" nor "real estate salesperson" is held to include: Any person, partnership, association, or corporation, who or that, as a bona fide owner, lessee, or lessor, performs any of the previously stated acts as to property owned, or leased by them
